propositions: A single JSON object in LLM text is decoded twice — once from _all_json_objects and once from json.loads(text) — creating duplicate candidates before validation.
_select_and_validate uses identity (is not) rather than equality to detect semantic conflict, treating separately constructed but equal Pydantic instances as distinct ambiguous candidates.

Native structured replies yield false multiple-candidate warnings with semantically identical first and last validated values, despite genuine conflict detection being correct for truly distinct candidates.
Deduplicating equal decoded dicts in discovery order before validation eliminates false ambiguity warnings while preserving last-valid-wins for genuinely different candidates.
